title: Public Law 119-74: Commerce, Justice, Science; Energy and Water Development; and Interior and Environment Appropriation…
summary: H.R. 6938, "Commerce, Justice, Science; Energy and Water Development; and Interior and Environment Appropriations Act, 2026", originated in the House of the 119th Congress and became Public Law 119-74 on 2026-01-23, according to Congress.gov.
